blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Rio de Janeiro. On arrival, meet your driver for the transfer to Búzios.

After the cities and waterfalls, the beach portion of the journey begins. The peninsula has more than 20 beaches. The waters in Ferradura and João Fernandes bays are generally calmer, while the more exposed Geribá Beach often has waves. The beaches are relatively close to one another, yet differ in shape, exposure to the ocean and sea conditions.

Check in at your hotel. Four nights of leisure lie ahead, with no compulsory excursions.

Búzios offers plenty of ways to relax without travelling far. Ferradura and João Fernandes are good choices for calmer water, while Geribá is more exposed to the ocean and known for its waves. It is easy to move between beaches across the peninsula and choose a different stretch of coast each day. After the lively Sambadrome and the powerful torrents of Iguazu, this part of the tour reveals an entirely different side of Brazil.
